<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak, characteristic of a single chlorine atom, and a relatively high M+1 peak (~16 %) consistent with the natural abundance of ¹³C in a molecule containing many carbons—we can definitively identify carbon and chlorine in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
